name: TC-1 – Manual order entry and processing (Happy Path)
precondition: Portal is deployed and reachable. The "Un vistazo a tus ordenes" table is empty.

expected.text: "Procesar" is disabled before the order is added and enabled after.
After processing, the order appears in "Un vistazo a tus ordenes".
The "No hay resultados disponibles" empty state disappears.
